subject: Initial tenant keying play and handoff for Brightwell
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightwell.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initial tenant keying play and handoff for Brightwell

Hi Sara —

Congrats on signing! I’m Lukas (Implementation PM) and I’ll own the first-mile tenant setup and API key seeding with you. Goal is a minimal-friction handoff so your engineers can start hitting the sandbox and then the prod tenant next week.

High-level play we’ll run:
- Create Brightwell tenant in Redwood and seed two projects (sandbox + prod).
- Invite up to 5 admin users, map roles using the attached role matrix.
- Seed service account (ephemeral) for initial integration and one long-lived API key if requested by procurement.
- Configure SSO hint (Okta) and KMS integration if you want server-side key wrap.

Asks from your side (please reply in-line):
1) Tenant canonical name we should use (example: brightwell-main)
2) Admin list (name + email + role: owner/admin/dev) — max 5 for now
3) SSO provider and IdP metadata (Okta/OneLogin/Azure)
4) Any compliance constraints (KMS/HSM, allowed regions, data retention)
5) Preferred kickoff window for a 30-minute handoff call (I’m available 11/10-11/12, PT mornings)

I attached: redwood-onboarding-guide.pdf and initial-admin-role-matrix.csv — Monica will update the matrix after you confirm admins.

If Procurement needs a point of contact, Ben is cc’d — he can assist with invoicing/KMS procurement questions.

Next steps from our end once you confirm: create tenant, invite listed admins, seed a service account and share the initial API key via our secure channel, and schedule a short walkthrough.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Brightwell live.

— Lukas Meyer
Implementation PM, Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-onboarding-guide.pdf, initial-admin-role-matrix.csv

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightwell.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial tenant keying play and handoff for Brightwell

Thanks Lukas — happy to kick this off. Answers inline below.

> 1) Tenant canonical name
brightwell-main (please include lowercase, dashed)

> 2) Admin list
- Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightwell.ai> — Owner
- David Chen <david.chen@brightwell.ai> — Admin
- Priya Rao <priya.rao@brightwell.ai> — Dev

(We’ll keep to 3 for now.)

> 3) SSO
We use Okta. I’ll share the IdP metadata XML in a follow-up email to this thread (sending to you and Monica).

> 4) Compliance constraints
- We need audit logs retained for 12 months; keys are managed in AWS KMS (account: brightwell-kms).
- No EU data residency required for this initial rollout.

> 5) Preferred kickoff window
Can you do 11/12 at 10:00 PT? That works for our Eng and Security SMEs.

Also: Procurement will want a copy of the initial API key handling plan. I’ve cc’d procurement@brightwell.ai on this reply. I’ve uploaded the signed MSA to DocuSign already.

Sara
VP Product, Brightwell
sara.liu@brightwell.ai | +1 212-555-0134

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightwell.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial tenant keying play and handoff for Brightwell

Perfect — 11/12 10:00 PT is scheduled (30 min). Calendar invite sent to all.

I updated the role matrix based on Sara’s admin list and attached admin-role-matrix-v2.csv.

On the call I’ll walk through:
- tenant and project naming conventions
- invite flow and owner escalations
- API key seeding and rotation cadence (we recommend short-lived service accounts + one long-lived key only if procurement requires it)
- SSO bootstrapping steps (we’ll import Okta metadata)

Ben — we’ll need procurement to confirm whether Brightwell wants a long-lived prod key or ephemeral-only. Can you follow up after the call?

Thanks — Monica
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightwell.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial tenant keying play and handoff for Brightwell

Sara / team — quick update before the kickoff: we created the tenant and pre-seeded the sandbox project.

Summary of items completed today:
- Tenant: brightwell-main (created)
- Sandbox project: brightwell-main-sandbox (created)
- Prod project: brightwell-main-prod (created, not promoted)
- Invites sent to admins: sara.liu@brightwell.ai, david.chen@brightwell.ai, priya.rao@brightwell.ai — check your spam if you don’t see them.
- Temporary service account created: brightwell-svc-init-1 (permission scope: project:sandbox/read/write). We will rotate the service account key after the integration test and provide rotation instructions in the secure channel.
- Seed plan attached (seed-plan.md) — includes schedule to seed one short-lived API key for sandbox (immediately after kickoff) and a procurement decision window for the prod key (Ben to confirm).

Next steps for kickoff (11/12 10:00 PT):
- Confirm IdP metadata (Sara) so we can start Okta exchange.
- Walk through role matrix and finalize any tweaks (Monica)
- Run a quick test call to the sandbox endpoint and exchange the initial API key via our secure vault (I’ll generate and push to the vault during the call).

If everything looks good we’ll plan the prod key seed for 11/16 (tentative) pending procurement.

Ben — can you nudge procurement to confirm whether Brightwell needs a long-lived prod key or if ephemeral-only is sufficient?

Thanks all — see you on the call.

— Lukas
Implementation PM, Redwood Inference
attachments: seed-plan.md
